Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 86: August 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #86 shipped to subscribers in July 2008 (bearing the cover date of August 2008 for Issue 86). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #86 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media content:

GRID (arcade-style circuit and street racing)
Universe at War: Earth Assault (real-time strategy)
Condemned 2: Bloodshot (first-person psychological survival horror)
Operation Darkness (turn-based tactical RPG)
Iron Man (third-person superhero action)
Wits & Wagers (Xbox Live Arcade trivia party game)
Buku Sudoku (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered five custom downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews and trailers for upcoming titles, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
